prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the supplied 1080 x 2400 portrait rocky lake game background.
Primary request: reposition ALL water, shorelines, rocks and roots so NONE can intersect or be cut off by the game board. Preserve the existing chunky cartoon style, very thick dark-plum outlines, simple broad cel shading, pale warm gray/taupe floor and muted blue lake. This is a layout correction, not a new theme.
Critical invisible protected area: on the 1080 x 2400 canvas, the entire top 1600 pixels (top TWO THIRDS) must be continuous unobstructed dry floor. Keep that whole area FREE of water, shorelines, boulders, pebbles, roots, moss or other objects. Only faint FLAT low-contrast taupe floor mottling is permitted there, no raised pebble highlights. Extend matching existing ground over removed details, with no rectangular patch or visible protected-area boundary. DO NOT draw any grid, board, frame, dashed line, safe-area overlay or UI. The actual game grid is added separately.
Keep a wide natural dry clearing. All illustrated decorative items begin BELOW y=1640 (68.3% height), leaving an additional ground buffer under the protected area:
- Move the mossy gray stone to the lower LEFT, fully within x=70..275 and y=1650..1790. Same bold silhouette, simple 2-tone flat facets, small moss accent. Its uppermost pixel and dark outline must remain below y=1640.
- Place the short brown root separately toward the lower middle, around x=400, y=1860, bounding box x=310..510, y=1790..1950. Dry ground, distinct diagonal; no touching stone or shore.
- Only two or three small unequal outlined pebbles, scattered away from one another on lower dry land, all below y=1700. No rows, repeated pairs, or clustered pile.
- Remove the large left ledge and every other stone currently above y=1640.
LAKE: keep a LARGE lake with water continuing beyond the RIGHT and BOTTOM edges, but MOVE THE ENTIRE SHORELINE DOWN. Its first entrance from the right edge is around y=1660, never above y=1640. In the upper part of the lake (y=1660..1800) keep it near the right side, x=850..1080. Then let the bold irregular shore bend gradually left toward x=650 at y=1950, x=450 at y=2150, and x=130 at the bottom. This leaves a broad dry clearing above and left of the lake. NO water at all above y=1640. Use the same thick confident 18–22px dark plum shoreline, narrow pale bank, simple blue-gray regions and at most two broad ripple/reflection shapes. Keep lake clearly separated from root and stones. Do not make a small enclosed puddle.
Retain consistent floor color with the original board; quiet, simple, overhead continuous ground with no horizon, walls, perspective or shadows suggesting the board floats. Full bleed, opaque, exact 9:20 portrait, 1080 x 2400. Output only finished background art with NO labels, board or characters.
refinement_prompt: Precise localized edit to this exact rocky lake background. KEEP all rocks, root, pebbles, bold outlines, colors, ground texture and image dimensions exactly unchanged. Move ONLY the uppermost lake shoreline down: the existing water and dark shoreline currently begin at about 63% height at the right edge, which is too high. From there, slope the bank down-left to the existing shore at roughly 80% height. Absolutely NO lake water, dark shoreline, bank or shadows anywhere above 71% height. Keep a broad dry clearing above the lake. Preserve the lake below 80% height unchanged, still extending off right and bottom edges, same large lake and very thick plum shore outline with a narrow pale bank. Do not add anything, do not move the rocks or root, no board or UI. Keep 9:20 portrait, opaque.
final_refinement_prompt:

Keep the small pebbles few, scattered, entirely below 73.5% height, no other objects above 68.4%. Do not change the whole-image crop or add new objects. No grid, frame, UI or labels. Strict top-down flat floor and lake, original 1080x2400 portrait 9:20.

Keep each object's size, horizontal position, colors, thick outlines and shape EXACTLY the same. Fill the vacated positions with matching pale mottled dry floor. Do not move the lower-left pebble and do not change the water or shoreline. Do not add any items.
